mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_rebate_claim_task (post_id, user_id, period_key, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, finish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{periodKey}, #{state}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{finishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, user_id, period_key, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, finish_time, create_time, update_time FROM post_rebate_claim_task WHERE state = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE post_rebate_claim_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW())
UPDATE post_rebate_claim_task SET state = 1, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state = 0
UPDATE post_rebate_claim_task SET state = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0
